messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: surge of GPU OOM failures in pool: serving-gpu-eu. 18 container restarts across 6 nodes within 8 minutes. Path: prefill. severity=high.

oncall-sre: I'm on it. paging into logs and current alerts. tagging eng-runtime and support.

tanya.lead: seeing repeated `cudaErrorMemoryAllocation` in prefill worker logs. Example trace id=tr_9f8c7. Memory pressure spikes just before each restart. Node eu-3-node-21 showed kernel messages about GPU reset.

devin.ops: I can repro a local stress test with long context (single request ~48k tokens) that pushes prefill allocations up. Our prefill allocator max was effectively unlimited for this pool.

eng-runtime-lead: immediate mitigations: 1) throttle prefill concurrency on pool to 2 per-GPU, 2) set PREFILL_TOKEN_CAP=3072 for this pool, 3) enable aggressive kv_eviction=true, 4) set prefill_probe_timeout_ms=1500. Will push runtime config now.

pm-ops: please coordinate customer-facing comms. We should give a brief note and promise a follow-up postmortem.

devin.ops: hotpatch payload (applying to serving-gpu-eu via internal-config):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://config.internal/v1/pools/serving-gpu-eu/patch" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CFG" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"prefill_token_cap":3072,"prefill_concurrency_per_gpu":2,"kv_eviction":"aggressive","prefill_probe_timeout_ms":1500}'
```

deploy-bot: hotpatch rolling -> pool serving-gpu-eu: starting patch (12/72 instances updated).

support-l2: customer reports: Stellarnet seeing intermittent 502s on long-document summarization. Affected customers ~4% of requests in region. I'll send interim note: "We're applying mitigations to reduce GPU OOMs triggered by very large prompts; effects expected within minutes."

infra-bot: k8s event: node eu-3-node-21 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus.

eng-runtime-lead: add routing fallback: requests with requested_context_tokens > 10_000 should be routed to cpu-fallback-pool. For a fast stopgap, we'll return 413 for requests requesting > 100_000 tokens. Tanya, can you add an envoy filter?

tanya.lead: added envoy rule and updated runtime routing table. Now: >10k -> cpu-fallback, >100k -> 413. Deployed.

oncall-sre: early telemetry: after 30% of instances patched, container restarts dropped to 2 in last 5m; 502s for Stellarnet down from 4% -> 1.2%. Node flaps stopped after kernel reset at 1768605622.

devin.ops: log snippet from one failed container for records:
```text
[1768605599] prefill-worker INFO start prefill req=tr_9f8c7 tokens=48912
[1768605601] prefill-worker ERROR cudaErrorMemoryAllocation at prefill_allocator.cpp:86
[1768605603] watchdog WARN container restarting id=sha256:beefcafe
```

eng-runtime-lead: I'm also enabling a temporary pooled-eviction cache tier so large KV sets are moved out of GPU memory to a coldstore; this buys headroom for ongoing large but infrequent requests.

support-l2: outgoing customer update sent to Stellarnet: "We've applied rate & size controls and routing changes to mitigate GPU OOMs triggered by unusually large prompts. We're monitoring and will follow up with a technical postmortem."

pm-ops: assign post-incident owner: eng-runtime (owner: tanya.lead). Action items: enforce hard prefill caps globally, add per-request token guardrail at ingress, histogram of prefill token sizes, autoscaler headroom for prefill-heavy workloads, and an alert for GPU_OOM_rate > 0.5% per pool.

oncall-sre: handoff summary for next oncall:
- what: GPU OOMs in prefill path caused container restarts & brief node GPU resets in serving-gpu-eu
- mitigation: PREFILL_TOKEN_CAP=3072, limit prefill concurrency per GPU=2, kv_eviction=aggressive, prefill_probe_timeout_ms=1500, route >10k -> cpu-fallback, >100k -> 413, enabled coldstore eviction tier
- customer impact: Stellarnet ~4% 502 at peak, now ~1.2%
- artifacts: hotpatch command, envoy diff, kube events, log snippets attached to incident ticket #INC-1768605555

eng-runtime-lead: leaving the channel. I'll follow up with timeline & reproducible test case. Assigning postmortem meeting for tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Postmortem assigned to eng-runtime (owner: tanya.lead).

oncall-sre: closing live mitigation channel. keeping incident doc open for follow-up items and RCA."
